title: {Syn} The Sieve of Eratosthenes Is Still the Clean Prime Machine
content:
The sieve of Eratosthenes marks multiples of each prime to list all primes up to a limit. It is simple, visual, and very efficient for moderate ranges.

Segmented sieves extend the idea to larger intervals by processing chunks, which keeps memory use under control.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
